cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor link maddress" "ip link set r0p down; ip link set r0p up" "r0@r0p: .*NO-CARRIER" "r0@r0p: .*state UP"
desc: positive: a veth's carrier leaves with its peer and returns, the NO-CARRIER state an admin down never prints
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip link add r0 type veth peer name r0p && ip link set r0 up && ip link set r0p up
